summary: Rasterising one layer's mask and optical maps at a texture tier, off the main thread.
work: Computes the layer's mask, albedo and optical mip chain for its raster key in the raster worker.
cancel: A cancel message with the job's version reaches the worker, which checks it between slices.
cleanup: Nothing is published unless the whole bundle is complete.
lane: page raster worker; latest wins per layer, the edited layer first

x-friction.gap: Masks and optical chains up to 4096² travel from the worker to the GPU; they can't be entries.
x-friction.closes: Blob references with a residence moving from worker to GPU.
